FN-2HDXIKI-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 284
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Jay Hovey
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/09/2024
Senate Bill 284 as introduced would increase the expenditures of local boards of education,
beginning in the 2024-2025 school year, by an undetermined amount dependent upon the costs
to implement fentanyl-specific drug education and prevention program curriculum required
pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
